headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates continued their winning streak, pulling off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a grand slam that accounted for 6 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks) was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, while Chris Martin (Texas Rangers) is out with a right shoulder impingement. Other notable injuries include Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds) with a blister on his left index finger, William Kempner (Miami Marlins) with a right elbow sprain, and Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves) with left elbow inflammation.

The MLB trade market was active, with several teams making moves. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired SS Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros, while the Minnesota Twins received RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a grand slam that accounted for 6 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Bubba Chandler pitched 4.2 innings with six strikeouts for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, falling short of a comeback. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers in a one-sided game, securing a 14-5 victory. Impact players for the Pirates included Nick Gonzales and Jacob Gonzalez, while the Brewers' Jackson Chourio and Ryan O'Hearn had notable performances.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Lane Thomas and Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers Roster**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The SS was previously acquired by the Brewers in a trade with the Houston Astros.
